gem.incomingTip:
Incoming damage
x / y  —  the HP you'll take if you play no more block (current block + end-of-turn relics)
over the minimum you could take by also playing your hand's block optimally.
gem.offenseTip:
Your damage
x / y  —  the most you can deal before the enemies act
over the most before your next turn (that + scheduled damage like poison).
Hover an enemy to scope to it; the energy gem glows green when you can kill it.
